verdict.rationale: Weave ships automated LLM-judge scorers, built-in guardrails (hallucination, bias, PII, toxicity detection), and 'signals' that automatically classify agent interactions and surface failure modes, which count as AI-generated insights on logged data (docs-8, docs-16, docs-22, docs-28, docs-36). It also supports agent-driven auto-iteration loops via MCP/skills where coding agents read Weave data and act on it (docs-20, docs-43), but this is more agent-orchestrated than a native 'suggestions' UI feature, and all evidence is vendor documentation with no independent/hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: independent verification of insight quality, concrete first-party example of the product itself proposing prompt/code changes (vs. relying on external agents), and UI screenshots/demos of generated suggestions.
